feats.title: Invigorating Critical
feats.description: The first time you score a critical hit with a divine attack power during an encounter, an ally adjacent to you or adjacent to the target regains hit points equal to 10 + your Wisdom.

feats.title: Pervasive Light
feats.description: When you hit a target that has vulnerability to radiant damage with an attack that does not deal radiant damage, you deal extra damage equal to that vulnerability.

feats.title: Saving Grace
feats.description: When you succeed on a saving throw, you can choose not to end the effect you saved against and instead allow an ally within 5 squares of you to make a saving throw with a bonus equal to your Wisdom.

feats.title: Armored by Faith
feats.requirements: 11th level, any divine class, Channel Divinity class feature
feats.description: When you use a Channel Divinity power, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom.

feats.title: Darkfoe
feats.requirements: 11th level, any divine class, Channel Divinity class feature
feats.description: When you use a Channel Divinity power, you and each ally within 10 squares of you gain resistance to necrotic damage equal to 5 + your Wisdom until the start of your next turn.
